reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I do care, but $25 to $30 a month is a lot when I can find a bottle of magnesium glycinate for the same money that lasts two or three months. I would wait for a bigger coupon or just grab a cheaper bottle.
objection: I do the price per day math and 83 cents to a dollar a day is way more than a regular bottle, and I still don't know if I'll feel any difference. The lab report is nice but I'm paying extra for the sachet.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings a box to around $15 to $18, or my doctor confirming I'm actually low and that this form is worth it.
